title: Prime deliveries arriving late
situation: Customers are experiencing delivery delays on Prime orders and need reassurance about their shipments now.

params.reply_en: We see your Prime delivery is running late. We are looking into the courier delay with your order and will email you an update shortly.
params.reply_ar: نحن ندرك تأخر تسليم طلبك المميز. نتابع سبب التأخير مع شركة الشحن وسنوافيك بالتحديث قريباً.

actions.why: Inform customers about the delivery delay investigation.

params.note: Prime delivery delays reported across multiple orders.

actions.why: Alert logistics to investigate the root cause of the shipping delays.

reply_en: We see your Prime delivery is running late. We are looking into the courier delay with your order and will email you an update shortly.
reply_ar: نحن ندرك تأخر تسليم طلبك المميز. نتابع سبب التأخير مع شركة الشحن وسنوافيك بالتحديث قريباً.

reply_other.fr: Nous constatons que votre livraison Prime est en retard. Nous vérifions le problème auprès du transporteur et vous enverrons une mise à jour prochainement.
reply_other.es: Vemos que tu entrega Prime llega tarde. Estamos revisando el retraso con la empresa de mensajería y te enviaremos una actualización en breve.

alternatives.why: Customers might be reacting to missing tracking scans rather than actual physical delays.
Complaints focus heavily on poor courier performance and lack of communication.
